promptInputs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One square vocabulary picture, neutral cream textured watercolor paper, muted olive and soft blue accents, delicate pencil outline, sparse props and generous margins. Input image 1 is ONLY bean proportions and drawing-style reference, not its scene. Every bean compact rounded egg/oval, body height about 1.5x width, short thin legs around 15% body height, tiny curved arms with simple endpoints, short curved antennae, small eyes and mouth. Avoid long thin bean body, long legs or fat human hands. Every bean exactly TWO arms rooted on opposite sides of body, arms meet clothing at actual sleeve openings, never through chest. Natural perspective, appropriate scale, feet grounded or seated with desk occlusion correct. Props must face their user correctly. No printed captions, words, labels, numbers, logos or watermark. Scene: A compact bean student sits naturally at a desk looking disappointed at a returned math test laid FLAT FACE UP on the desktop, with many simple red cross marks on answer boxes and no readable letters or numerals. The page faces upward and is naturally usable by the student, no upside-down paper, a closed textbook beside it hints forgotten study. Exactly two short arms from opposite body sides, one holding paper edge and the other resting at own side. Correct chair and desk occlusion, grounded short feet.
